name: Site Meta
description: Set meta tags per page as configurable entities.
project_description:
ABOUT 

---------

 The Site Meta module provides a flexible and easy method to set meta tags, such as page title, description, and keywords for nodes, views and other different pages. It also creates a field on node edit form to add custom meta for this node.

 CONFIGURATION 

-----------------------

 1. Navigate to Administration > Extend and enable the module.

 2. Navigate to Content > Site meta

 3. Here is a list of all site meta currently active on site. Site meta entry can be

 individually configured by selecting the "Edit" option.

 4. Click 'Add Sitemeta' to add a new meta for a page.

 5. You can also add meta info for a node site by visiting the node edit page and under

 advanced tab there is a Custom Meta tab, where you can set up a custom meta for

 this node.
